title: Concept: Permissive WebView capability enabled via webView.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true (kotlin) — review required
description: In kotlin, webView.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true grants the WebView a capability that crosses a security boundary. JavaScript enabled over navigable content reaches native bridges, file access exposes local storage, and universal file-URL access removes the same-origin limit between a local page and the filesystem. Keep the grant disabled unless the content is bundled (JavaScript disabled for navigable content).
applicability: kotlin application code that configures WebView instances; lexical scope.
risk: Local file disclosure and native bridge abuse; MEDIUM severity.
